title: Open questions, 15 Jan 2026
intro: Each question explains its own background, so you don't need to remember earlier messages.
Pick an option, or write your own answer in the box under it. Answers save in this browser as you go.

questions.title: Should profile photos be backed up?
context: Profile photos live in one storage bucket with no copy. If the bucket is lost, every user sees a blank avatar and has to upload again.
- A nightly copy to a second region costs about €1 a month at today's size.
- Photos are compressed to 400 px before upload, so the copy stays small.
**What each option leads to** is under the option.

options.label: Back them up nightly
options.detail: A lost bucket is restored from last night's copy. The privacy policy gains one line about the backup location.

options.label: No backup
options.detail: Nothing changes. A lost bucket means every user uploads again.
